ne28:1.1: And what is the conveying of a reversal?
ne28:2.1: “Therefore, of the one whose mind is guarded, right thought is his range”. This is the verse.
ne28:2.2: When tranquility and insight have been developed, extinguishment is the fruit: suffering has been fully understood, its origin has been abandoned, and the path has been developed in reverse order.
ne28:2.3: The conveying of a reversal has been applied.
